name: sheffield-masjids
description: Look up published mosque prayer times (adhan and iqamah) from Sheffield Masjids.

interface.shortDescription: Mosque prayer times: adhan and iqamah for listed mosques.
interface.longDescription: Ask for today's or a specific day's prayer times for mosques published on Sheffield Masjids. Search the directory, then get adhan and iqamah with Europe/London timezone. Powered by the same published timetable data used by Masjidly.
defaultPrompt: What are today's prayer times at Madina Masjid Sheffield?
Search Sheffield mosques named Huda, then get tonight's Maghrib and Isha iqamah.
When is Maghrib at Muslim Welfare House Sheffield on 2026-04-10?

review.release_notes: Initial remote MCP plugin: search_mosques and get_prayer_times over published Sheffield Masjids timetable data.

positive.scenario: Today's times for a known mosque slug
positive.prompt: Get today's prayer times for madina-masjid-sheffield
positive.expected_result: Returns adhan and iqamah for Europe/London today (or the requested date) with mosque metadata.

positive.scenario: Resolve mosque by name then fetch times
positive.prompt: What are Fajr and Maghrib at Madina Masjid Sheffield on 2026-04-10?
positive.expected_result: Resolves the mosque and reports separate adhan and iqamah values for 2026-04-10.

positive.prompt: Find Sheffield mosques with Huda in the name
positive.expected_result: Lists matching Sheffield directory entries with slugs and URLs.
Returns iqamah including Jummah when available, labeled separately from adhan.

positive.prompt: What time is Asr iqamah in Sheffield today?
positive.expected_result: Asks which mosque or lists candidates because iqamah varies by mosque.

negative.prompt: Calculate prayer times for a random GPS coordinate with no mosque
negative.expected_behavior: Does not invent astronomical times; explains coverage is limited to listed mosques.
Refuses the slash date format and asks for YYYY-MM-DD or omits date for today.

negative.prompt: Book me a flight to London and charge my card
negative.expected_behavior: Does not call tools for booking or payments; stays within prayer-time lookup.
